title: Judge Cross-Phase Regression Response
description: Structured response from the cross-phase regression judge call site (#4 per spec §6.9). Fires when tier-1 in a later phase reveals violations not present at the predecessor phase's exit commit.

decision.description: 'fix_in_place' stays in the current phase; 'reopen_prior_phase' rolls back to the named target phase; 'escalate' transitions to BLOCKED with operator notification.

target_phase.description: The phase to target for rollback or reference. Must be a valid ATDD phase name.

rationale.description: Human-readable rationale for the routing decision.
